pages.text: Nether expedition, day 2. $(item)Dilithium$() grows down here. Its lattice is porous to antimatter, which makes it the only practical regulator for an annihilation reactor.

Field notes: annihilation turns all the rest mass of matter and antimatter into energy - E = mc², the full amount, against under 1% for fusion. The hard part has always been holding antimatter without it touching anything. A crystal it can pass through gently is exactly what such a reactor needs.
Porous to antimatter. It regulates annihilation reactions.$(br2)Made in a crafting grid.
$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Dilithium Crystal$(): Annihilation Core, Block of Dilithium, Degenerate Matter Chunk, Dilithium Crystal, Magnetar Shard and more
